facts.fact: Udai came home alive from the guiding; the letter says Harish 'did not come home' and does not state that he died inside the Cairn. Ila's father found him at the thaw sitting against the hillside stone with his gloves on it (F490).
Sarala has kept the archive drawer thirty winters (ties to F426).
Ila swore the archive oath in a hall in Taravan when taking her commission; it is separate from the surveyor's oath at nineteen (F497).
